release_notes:
• Experimental Mode & Beta Pre-Release Channel toggle in Preferences
• In-App Google Drive API (OAuth 2.0) Sign-In with PKCE loopback authentication
• Cloud Import: Browse or paste a Google Drive folder link to download RAW/JPEG/Video shoots into local cache with live MB/s, ETA, and file telemetry
• Cloud Export: Upload culled Photo and Video sessions directly back to Google Drive with category selection checkboxes and resumable chunked progress
